actual_source.source_protein: PSE-4 class A beta lactamase (NOT FN1)
actual_source.rates: R1 and R2 s^-1 converted from deposited ms T1,T2 and delta method measurement uncertainty; NOE dimensionless

unit_tests: 8/8 PASS in dedicated BMRB-science workflow; general repository unit tests skip external-dependency tests when pynmrstar and scipy missing, dedicated science workflow executes full suite with pinned dependencies

actual_successful_actions.interpretation_of_actions: Actual executed source-validated model train/test output, not proposed workflow

training_validation.errors: reported per-residue errors; R1/R2 delta-method propagated; diagonal inverse variance weighting approximation, unknown covariance
training_validation.model_parameters: Per-residue fitted tau_c and S2, tau_e fixed 0.1ns, Rex=0 in all four; optional residue CSA and optional axial ratio, with NH axis polar angle fixed for illustration at 45 degrees, not experimental.
training_validation.test_selection: Frozen before fits but heldout 800 MHz known a priori problematic from independent literature, not prospective blind

CSA_M1_optimization_boundary_hits.note: Boundary fits indicate weak identification or model mismatch, not experimentally established residue CSA; parameter bounds frozen and not widened after seeing holdout.

independent_risk_assessment.known_source_issue: Published secondary diagnostic research identifies 800MHz PSE-4 R2 data inconsistency and potential spurious Rex estimates; primary score nevertheless includes ALL observations, secondary R1+NOE separately disclosed.
independent_risk_assessment.model_error_pattern: Variable-CSA improves heldout R1 and NOE but worsens heldout R2. The improvement is NOT uniform across observables.
independent_risk_assessment.anisotropy_not_supported_at_fixed_angle: Axial ratio fitted per residue and NH axis held at arbitrary 45°; near-zero change from isotropic baseline cannot establish physical anisotropy absent or present, because real residue NH orientations relative to global diffusion tensor are unknown and ratio is not globally shared.
independent_risk_assessment.unresolved: Need independent clean three-field dataset, physical NH axis orientation from experimental structure, globally shared diffusion tensor and stricter out-of-field tests before causal inferences.

next_action: Seek a genuinely clean second protein with matched published 3-field R1/R2/hetNOE and independent experimental angular tensor, or obtain validated corrected PSE-4 800MHz R2 source; do not alter prior frozen 800MHz scoring or declare source 6838 fully clean.
